name: @vibe/desktop
description: Electron desktop wrapper for the vibe-coding platform (macOS + Windows)

scripts.prepare:mac: cd ../.. && bun run --filter ./apps/client build && cd apps/desktop && bun scripts/build-server.ts darwin-arm64 && bun scripts/build-server.ts darwin-x64
scripts.prepare:win: cd ../.. && bun run --filter ./apps/client build && cd apps/desktop && bun scripts/build-server.ts win32-x64
scripts.package:mac: bun run prepare:mac && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.package:win: bun run prepare:win && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win
